# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure — Rosemont Street Bakery

**Report ID:** RSB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** Tuesday, March 12, 2024
**Date of Report:** Friday, March 15, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team
**Distribution:** Owner, Kitchen Manager, Facilities Coordinator, All Staff (summary version)

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 2:40 a.m. on March 12, the walk-in cooler at Rosemont Street Bakery stopped maintaining temperature following a partial power interruption. The unit did not restart when power was restored because its compressor protection switch had tripped, a condition requiring a manual reset. No staff were on site overnight. The failure was discovered at 4:15 a.m. by the opening baker. Internal cooler temperature had risen to 61°F (16°C), exceeding the safe holding threshold of 41°F (5°C) for approximately 90–120 minutes. All temperature-sensitive inventory in the cooler was discarded as a precaution. No product reached customers, and no illnesses were reported.
